verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can 'implement entirely new features' and build internal tools, can be started from Slack/Teams feature-request threads, and can connect to Figma via MCP integrations, so a design-to-code path is plausible. Nothing documents a mockup-to-implementation workflow or shows a non-engineer shipping without engineering review, and community comments question how reliably its output is fully correct. Missing for 10: an explicit documented design/mockup-to-code workflow, evidence that the Figma integration turns designs into working UI, guidance for non-engineer users, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end delivery without engineering involvement.
